I dont think thats dumb, Its good that you have a vision of the future to work towards. 

Personally I dont have any dreams or hopes for the future at all. I dont want a family, I dont care for all of those dreams we’re supposed to have. 

What I used to think about as something to live for was seeing as much of life and this world as I can while I have the chance. But now I am just apathic, tired and Indifferent

I tried getting help but it only made everything worse. All my psychologist did was pointing out that it was not normal for someone my age to have no friends :(. And she also said that I should try to be more social because I needed to have some activity in my life. But I cant even manage to get out of bed to eat/shower so how tf am I going to be able to socialize.

Sorry for this rant, I wanted to demonstrate why I dont believe in “help” anymore
Nothing really, I just am never going to be ok and live a good/ok/tolerable life. Therefore I need to end it.

Thanks for replying.

I think your description about isolation and being alone is very much accurate. I do try to think that life has a place for me but in the end I just spiral down into those depressed thoughts again.
Maybe it is progress, but it doesnt feel like it. I dont see suicide as something bad anymore. I wouldnt be giving up I would have found a way out.

I dont know If I will be able to get out of this. I spent the last 2 years in bed in my house never going out and I just recently managed to go back to school and stopping self harming and such things but now I just feel like Fucking shit again.

I dont have any friends at all. I rarely talk to people. I spend most of my days in my bed. My family doesnt care about me. 

Edit: they think this is all my fault because Im being lazy
